edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the privileged owner slot directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
The Owned constructor consumes msg.sender to establish the initial owner.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _to address into the sensitive pendingOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership authorizes execution by comparing msg.sender with pendingOwner.
acceptOwnership reads pendingOwner as the authorization source for the ownership takeover.
acceptOwnership rewrites the owner state variable with the caller address.
acceptOwnership copies the current owner into the oldOwner local before overwriting it.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
The isWhitelisted modifier reads whitelisted[msg.sender] to authorize the caller.
Whitelist membership is keyed on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
addToWhitelist grants access rights by writing _user into the whitelisted mapping.
removeFromWhitelist revokes access rights by deleting _user from the whitelisted mapping.
enableWhitelist turns the access-control gate back on.
disableWhitelist removes the access-control gate for all readers.
The Whitelisted constructor enables whitelist enforcement by default.
setAggregator writes the owner-supplied _aggregator address into the aggregator delegation target.
The AggregatorProxy constructor forwards its _aggregator argument to setAggregator.
The aggregator state variable is the destination address of all external calls, so a malicious aggregator controls the callee code.
setAggregator stores an unvalidated address that later becomes the target of every external call.
